name: MVGS_CS_CNV_TYPE
title: MV-GenomSeq copy number alteration type
description: Six-level copy number alteration type of the BfArM KDK (molecular.copyNumberVariants[].cnvType). MII MTB `component:cnv-type` uses the undefined DNPM/bwHC system http://bwhc.de/mtb/genetics-copy-number-variant with three levels only (loss, low-level-gain, high-level-gain); this CodeSystem keeps the full ordinal (DISCUSS-TD #17, REPRESENTATIONS #17).

property.description: Ordinal position from strongest loss to strongest gain (unspecified levels between)

concept.definition: Homozygous (complete) loss of the gene copies.
Loss of one gene copy (heterozygous deletion).
Copy number loss, extent not specified.
Copy number gain, level not specified.
